title: blemees-workflow input topic directory
description: Schema for the shared `input-topics.json` file. Catalogues the topics agents may invoke `request-input` on. Working states reference these topics by id via `State.input_topics`.

topics.description: Map of topic-id → topic definition. Use a `general` topic for catch-all escalation; list specialised ids for structured questions (e.g., `clarify-scope`, `needs-arch-review`).

description.description: What kind of input this topic captures. Read by humans choosing what to answer.

agent_prepares.description: Optional template path the agent fills before invoking `request-input` with this topic. Mirrors the HCP catalog's same-named field.

rationale.description: Optional inline rationale or pointer to a sidecar markdown file.
